title: BSpeedRunRandom
description: BSpeedRunRandom is an exciting Minecraft Paper plugin that adds a randomized speedrun challenge to your server. Players can race to find a randomly selected block or item.
body:
BSpeedRunRandom is an exciting Minecraft Paper plugin that adds a randomized speedrun challenge to your server. Players can race to find a randomly selected block or item, with a fun spinning animation to pick the target! Admins can start, stop, and reroll the challenges, and even specify custom targets. The plugin features real-time inventory checking, sound effects, and clear win announcements to keep gameplay engaging and competitive.

**Features:**

- Random selection of blocks or items for speedrun targets with a spinning animation
 
- Support for custom target selection by admins
 
- Real-time inventory checks to detect winners instantly
 
- Commands with tab completion for ease of use: /bspeedrun start|stop|reroll|help

- Commands for custom target use: /bspeedrun start blocks/items name
 
- Sound effects for spinning, target selection, and winner celebration
 
- Permissions support — only ops/admins can control the speedrun
 
- Clean and intuitive chat and title messages to keep players informed
  

**Supported Versions:**

- Tested on Paper 1.16.5, compatible with newer Minecraft versions (1.16+)
